scope: Workbench integration; no global Meddle or FlowElement shape change implied

command.rule: Requester is resolved from authenticated context, never trusted from input. Duplicate commandID with different canonical payload hash is rejected. Mutations revalidate current authority.

mountContext.rule: Separate authenticated host/transport context, not Meddle payload or authority. Server validates binding to session/source. Unsupported bridge fails closed.

event.rule: Persist before publish. Emitter identity is verified through runtime source and authenticated envelope; a claimed event field is insufficient.

commitReceipt.rule: Only committed means authoritative storage accepted. Chronicle/index projection cursors remain separate. Failure or unknown is not success.

outbox.rule: Durable alongside authoritative commit or derived idempotently from journal. At-least-once delivery, deduplicate by eventID.

eventNotification.rule: Flow may carry only a permitted minimal notice. Fetching payload requires same authorization. Do not broadcast private content/counts to shared listeners.

snapshotCursor.rule: Subscribe then snapshot and reconcile buffered events. eventsSince returns explicit gap/snapshot-required when history compacted; cursor opaque and scoped.

packageRevision.rule: Immutable published revision. Skills and context refs include version/hash. Package selection adds no grants.

turnBinding.rule: Immutable after dispatch; actual provider/model recorded in result, no silent fallback. Revocation checked before dispatch. Credentials remain protected references outside prompt.

invocationReceipt.rule: State accepted/running/completed/failed/cancelRequested/cancelled/unknown must come from actual provider/adapter. Late response keeps original binding.

actionProposal.rule: Preview is not approval. Bind target IDs/environment/PR SHAs; revalidate authority and fresh target at execution. Source/proposal text untrusted.

effectAttempt.rule: Reserve durably before external await; allowed state transitions documented below. Query same ID after uncertainty; replay never dispatches.

effectReceipt.rule: Only validated executor receipt may claim queue/running/merge/deploy outcome. No receipt from model prose or an imported generic done status.

shareProjection.rule: Explicit minimal copy with distinct ID/audience. Does not change private originals; revocation/deletion semantics explicit for this copy.

query.rule: Authorized corpus before ranking/count/snippets, actual requester server-side. Modes text/purpose. Cursor/filter bound to same scope and grant epoch.

historyResult.rule: Only authorized payload/snippet. Open/model use revalidates. Index lag distinct from empty results; cached count/snippet/embedding inherits same boundary.

migrationReceipt.rule: Idempotent per source ID/revision. Private exports not in Git; legacy gaps explicitly marked, no invented text.

releaseIntent.rule: Only Admin/canonical deploy queue executor. Fresh claim/capacity check and staging evidence; a merged commit alone is not deployed.

commandRules.draftSnapshot: Required for draft operations: mountInstanceID, fieldSequence, fieldKey, text; captured at button event, not inferred from global active state. Server validates against mountContext; package persistence has its own expectedPackageRevision.
commandRules.legacyCompatibility: Existing v0 callers remain behind explicit versioned adapter. Never infer a mounted caller session from legacy global selected state. Unknown wire version fails closed.

effectTransitionRule: Transitions require authoritative evidence, including resolution from unknown. Replay reconstructs state only and never starts an attempt. A new attempt after terminal failure is separate, authorized and linked.
